1.1.0: Looks Wippy facts up in the Wippy docs page by page, names the page it used, and follows the project's runtime build when the two disagree.
1.0.0: First version: builds apps and services in Lua on Wippy as supervised processes that talk by messages, with narrow security policies per entry.
Manages modules and dependencies by version range, from the module registry or from git tags, and backs up and checks the lock around every resolve.
Works test first with the runtime's own runner, probes the runtime's Lua for known quirks, and checks every change in the running app, not only in tests.
